note: Village of Stockholm park campground on Lake Pepin, with a swimming beach, boat ramp and a historic 750-ft fishing pier. Fewer sites are open during high water. Self-pay at the entrance. --Claude
summary: Village park page and the 2016 park plan (site map) read: FCFS only, $27 RV with 50-A electric ($150/week, $500/month), 30-night max; May 15 - Oct 15 (stored approx 04-01/10-31 -> 05-15/10-15); 23 sites. Lakefront -> lakeview (west sites behind a tree band, south sites past a marshy point). Phone 651-380-8517 -> 715-448-0896.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored lakefront (sweep value, no --AWH) -> lakeview. Closest sites are 10 and 11 at the lake corner (~44.4807,-92.2641; the village's plan calls them 'Camping sites closest to the Lake'), FCFS nightly.
